scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix apps/express" "npm run dev --prefix apps/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/express && npm run build --prefix apps/frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix apps/express && npm install --prefix apps/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix apps/express && npm run lint --prefix apps/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix apps/express && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/frontend
